closed_findings.closure: Each observation is now checked for dict shape, exact immutable bytes and dict receipt before aggregate size checking or individual mapping. Five malformed-shape cases cover the boundary.
closed_findings.finding: A non-dict observation, non-bytes raw payload or non-dict receipt could escape with an incidental attribute/type error before the intended bounded refusal path.

scope_limits: This review covers the pure calculation module and its owner tests. It does not authorize runtime activation or review the subsequently integrated runner.

The caller must validate actual registered source/model/cohort bytes, create honest source-observation clocks, persist plans before collecting execution observations, and maintain a single non-branching persisted state chain.
Content hashes and caller-attested publication clocks identify records; they are not cryptographic proof of an external broker event.
Virtual bid/ask actions with assumed slippage are research observations, not fills, executable orders or independently calibrated forecast performance.
If no eligible closing quote is observed by the explicit terminal window, terminal_all_flat can remain false. This is retained as an unresolved virtual position, not successful completion of trading.
The unchanged reused arithmetic and selector modules retain their separate source-bound tests; this review did not rerun them.
Owner reports 60 focused passing tests in the bound XML. Reviewer reread source and relevant tests without an independent test rerun.
verified_semantics: One fixed GBP_USD official-midpoint initial native H1 curve is bound by curve/model/cohort/source identities and original issue/reference/target/terminal price. Later replacement or revision is refused.
The five virtual arms have separate sealed position/cash states and reuse the same observed quote election; they do not constitute five independent market trials.
All choices finish before an actual plan-created clock is sampled; a later caller-attested durable publication receipt is required before an eligible quote read can start.

The elected quote is the earliest verified current, explicit tradeable GBP_USD observation in the fixed post-publication and one-second post-computation window, not the most profitable supplied observation.
Original quote market times and actual read-completion availability remain separate. A still-current tick may predate the plan; no claim of a new broker tick or actual broker fill is made.
Explicit retained, stale, future, non-tradeable and pre-publication observations cannot create a virtual fill. Observation count and aggregate byte bounds precede parsing.

The fixed USD 2500 sizing, five-basis-point entry spread cap, 0.1-basis-point slippage per leg, one-hour maximum holding and original native target are retained. Failed rotation leaves the entire original state intact.

The USD hold/exit/rotation selector uses the remaining initial forecast terminal price with current quote valuation. The no-rotation curve arm remains distinct; zero remaining forecast is a value, not missing data.
The legacy selector arm is explicitly a reference using the new predeclared S5 momentum heuristic, not a claim of equivalence to old deployed candidate production.
The momentum candidate is recomputed from retained raw MBA source and verified receipt/consumer clocks; its score mapping remains explicitly uncalibrated.

A terminal plan may record an explicit missing decision-quote refusal, but an exit still needs a later valid observed quote. Without one, the open position remains unresolved and no closing price or profit is invented.

Actual settlement-computation completion is sampled after arm calculations and becomes the next state availability. The source cutoff remains separate; an earlier scheduled decision cannot consume a later-known state.
Pending settlement retains the original state and records actual computation completion. Reapplying a completed plan to its advanced state is refused.
Pure output serialization copies input mappings; planning and settlement do not mutate caller states or perform filesystem, account, order, runtime or network actions.
